Please describe the change in plain language so a reviewer can understand it without reading the diff first.

What changed

Explain the user-visible or technical change and the reason for it.

Impact and scope

Note the areas affected, important decisions, and anything intentionally left unchanged.

Validation

List the checks you ran and their result. Include relevant commands, tests, or browser verification.

Review notes

Call out anything that needs special attention, known limitations, follow-up work, or release considerations.

Before requesting review, confirm that the branch targets `dev` and that no secrets or generated artifacts are included.
